messages:
oliver: Quick question re: new hire accruals + year-end. We have a new PM starting 2026-12-15 (pro-rated hire). They observe a regional holiday on 2026-12-28 and want to move it to 2027-01-04 so they can join an interview panel. Because they're in probation, are they eligible for a swap/carryover? Also worried about hitting carryover caps with proration.

samira: Good set of questions. New hires are eligible for one-time swaps, but accruals are prorated. If the moved day becomes a PTO day in the next calendar year, Payroll will check prorated accruals vs. carryover cap. Typically:
- If the employee hasnt accrued the hours by year-end (due to proration), we require a manager-approved unpaid day or advance-of-PTO note.
- If they have accrued but moving the day would exceed the carryover softcap, file a "carryover exception" on the Time-off Adjustment form.

jamal: From Hiring Ops side: if the candidate starts 2026-12-15 and we need them for interviews the week of 12/28, we should confirm start date paperwork is complete. Also we often schedule new hires as "not eligible for interview panels" until after orientation week. If they want to help, we need manager approval + recruiting sign-off.

oliver: Ah ok. So two paths: 1) swap and manager marks it as unpaid if accruals aren't enough, or 2) manager approves an advance PTO (if manager agrees), which HR can record. Is there a standard field for "advance PTO for new hire" in the form?

samira: Yes, use Time-off Adjustment form -> type: "one-time swap / advance PTO". In the notes add "new hire proration - advance PTO" and attach manager approval. Example fields to include:
```
- type: one-time swap / advance PTO
- original_date: 2026-12-28
- new_date: 2027-01-04
- hire_start_date: 2026-12-15
- accrual_prorated: yes
- manager_approval: attach email
- coverage_plan: recruiting backup assigned
- payroll_action: advance PTO / carryover exception
```

payroll-bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for year-end accrual processing is 2026-12-20 23:59 UTC. Advance PTO requests submitted after cutoff require manual reconciliation. Link: https://redwood.example.com/payroll/cutoffs

jamal: Recruiting: if Oliver still needs the new hire on the panel, we prefer to have a backup interviewer and add the new hire only after orientation is confirmed. I'll flag the candidate panel and list backups. Also update the calendar invites.

oliver: Manager prefers to give an advance PTO day so the new hire can cover the panel. I'll get the approval email and submit the Time-off Adjustment now. If payroll needs manual reconciliation, what's turnaround?

samira: If manual reconciliation is required (post-cutoff or proration edge-case), Payroll aims for 5 business days but during year-end it can be 7-10 days. Include "payroll_reconciliation: yes" on the form and cc payroll@redwood.example.com.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-5602 (new-hire prorated advance PTO & year-end swap). Assigned to Samira. Please attach manager approval and recruiting coverage note.
